title: Family of victim in Darron Lee murder case plans to pursue potential claim against ChatGPT

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Family of victim in Darron Lee murder case plans to pursue potential claim against ChatGPT
sources.description: The murder case against former NFL first-round draft pick Darron Lee includes evidence that he used ChatGPT for advice on how to deal with an "unresponsive" person.
